ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a cyclic biological process schematic diagram, with multiple cell-like structures arranged according to arrows. The uppercase letter C is located next to the structure in the upper left; this structure is oval-shaped, has filamentous material inside, and has many small round or oval protrusions attached around the outer surface. Reasoning: The question asks for the name of stage C in the figure. According to biological rules, when spores form or are attached on the outside of the parent cell/structure, this process is called external sporulation. Therefore, stage C is external sporulation.
